title: Figure 3: Distribution of Object Sightings by Evaluation for All Years, by Year
description: Pie chart of object sightings by evaluation category (Unknown 434 = 19.7%, Astronomical 479 = 21.8%, Aircraft 474 = 21.5%, Balloon 339 = 15.4%, Insuf. info. 240 = 10.9%, Other 233 = 10.3%). An outer ring subdivides each category by year from 1947 to 1952, with 1952 the largest segment in every group. Caption: "FIGURE 3 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY EVALUATION FOR ALL YEARS WITH COMPARISONS OF EACH YEAR FOR EACH EVALUATION GROUP"; drawing A-7481, page 19.
